intents: inspect explicit Host Bridge or Synthesis diagnostics
useWhen: Ordinary bridge, library, run, cache, and index diagnostics did not explain the problem.
avoidWhen: Do not use debug commands for ordinary task routing or as a bypass around semantic commands.
